pages.title: Siege Isles
pages.creator: MCop
pages.description:
Siege Isles is a strategy game about taking control of a 3D island through troop movements and regional battles. Drag from a castle to a target region to dispatch soldiers. Your territories generate recruits automatically, and defeating an enemy garrison lets you capture its land.

The map affects each attack: soldiers travel along roads and around mountains, while towers fire at enemies passing nearby. Villages produce troops more quickly, and castles offer greater resistance. Support your armies with lightning, arrow attacks, and a rallying war cry as you expand across successive islands. Consider both a region's defenses and the route your troops will take before sending them into battle.

pages.title: Tropical Tiles Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear free pairs of beach-themed tiles in Tropical Tiles Mahjong. Build a winning streak for larger multipliers and look for Golden Tiles during the Mermaid Spell event. Work through the island layouts featuring fruit, flowers and sea creatures.

pages.title: Water Sort - Collections
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Pour colored water between bottles in Water Sort - Collections. Separate the layers until each container is filled with one color. Completing sixteen bottles opens another picture for your gallery, giving you a collection to build alongside the sorting puzzles.

pages.title: Treasure Champion - Chest Capture
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Work with a team to claim the central prize in Treasure Champion - Chest Capture. Carry the chest back to your base while avoiding traps and opposing players. Keep delivering it to score points for your side.

pages.title: Rabbit & Carrot
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Collect every carrot and reach the flag in Rabbit & Carrot. Jump over spikes, watch for sharp enemies and open gates along the way. Use bubbles to float across difficult sections as you tackle forty-eight stages.

pages.title: Square Punki Long Hand
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Reach past barriers with unusually long arms in Square Punki Long Hand. Stretch toward objects or characters to complete the task in each comic scene. Work out whether to grab, rescue or prank as the puzzles change.

pages.title: Journey Of Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description: Search enclosed locations for a way out in Journey Of Escape. Inspect objects, gather clues and solve the puzzles that control the exits. Follow the details you uncover through the collection of escape challenges.

pages.title: Math Lava: Tower Race
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Answer arithmetic questions to raise a platform in Math Lava: Tower Race. Each correct result builds more blocks beneath your character, carrying you away from the lava. Think quickly to climb ahead of the other players.

pages.title: Construction Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Operate heavy vehicles on a building site in Construction Simulator. Follow the current job and use the machinery to carry out each construction task. Get familiar with the controls as you move between the site's driving challenges.

pages.title: Goal io
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Compete in quick football matches in Goal io. Steer around rivals, get the ball into a scoring position and protect your own net when possession changes. Work with the space available on the pitch to find another opening.

pages.title: Save the Daddy
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Pull barriers in the right order in Save the Daddy. Look at where the monsters and hazards will move before removing a pin, then create a safe route for the man. Use each level's arrangement to keep danger away from him.

pages.title: Purrfect Scoops
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Serve frozen treats to animal customers in Purrfect Scoops. Choose flavors for cones and cups, then unlock more toppings and containers to expand the menu. Use the available power-ups when they help you manage the growing ice-cream shop.

pages.title: Tricky Arrow
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Fire arrows into a rotating target in Tricky Arrow. Wait for an opening that keeps your shot clear of arrows already stuck in the circle. Adjust your timing when the target changes its movement.

pages.title: Castle Craft
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Merge resources and uncover a fog-covered land in Castle Craft. Use ancient keys to reveal more territory while searching for traces of your missing family. Start with simple materials and combine them into the things needed for restoration.

pages.title: Elemental Gloves Magic Power
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Wield elemental attacks in Elemental Gloves Magic Power. Use fire, lightning and other powers against enemies, choosing the glove effect that helps with the next threat. Work through the arcade battles as more targets enter your path.

pages.title: Stack Blocks Connect Wooden Blocks!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Fit wooden shapes into a grid in Stack Blocks. Complete a line to make it disappear and leave room for the pieces that follow. Plan your placements to keep more options available and build a stronger score.

pages.title: Tank Sniper 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Take precise shots from behind cover in Tank Sniper 3D. Line up the target before exposing the tank to fire, then strike when the angle is clear. Move through the shooting challenges by eliminating the enemies ahead.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Shoot matching bubbles to climb in Bubble Shooter Witch Tower. Clear groups to progress through the stages, rescue pets and help restore the tower. Look for shots that open a route into bubbles tucked behind the front row.

pages.title: Whats Grandma Hiding
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Help restore an unexpected family mansion in Whats Grandma Hiding. Search the estate for clues and use what you discover to piece together its history. Follow the mystery as the restoration reveals more about your grandmother's past.

pages.title: Sniper Shooter 2
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Line up the target and fire in Sniper Shooter 2. Aim through the scene and tap when the enemy is in sight to complete the current assignment. Keep watching where each target moves as you progress through missions.

pages.title: Adventure of Flig
pages.creator: RAD BROTHERS
pages.description: Play through a story combining three activities in Adventure of Flig. Collect ammunition while running past obstacles, then use it in air-hockey battles with goals and shooting. Solve mazes between contests or share an air-hockey match on the same device.

pages.title: Murder Mafia
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Take down a mafia boss and disguise yourself as him in Murder Mafia. Watch the people around you for signs of betrayal once you occupy his place. Explore the different scenarios that unfold as you try to stay ahead of the next plot.

pages.title: Paradise Island 2
pages.creator: UAB Game Insight
pages.description: Develop a tropical resort in Paradise Island 2. Build and improve accommodation and attractions for different kinds of visitors. Expand the island's facilities as more tourists arrive and work toward turning the resort into a larger hotel business.

pages.title: Flying Car Game Police Games
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Drive on city roads or take to the air in Flying Car Game Police Games. Explore the police car's flying controls and switch between road travel and flight. Try jumps and aerial maneuvers as you move around the environment.

pages.title: Sir Knight
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: Fight through crowds and gather treasure in Sir Knight. Use the rewards to buy stronger armor and weapons, preparing for the next group of enemies. Watch the range of your sword as you move in to attack.

pages.title: Raccoon Retail
pages.creator: Pelican Party Studios
pages.description: Keep a supermarket clean in Raccoon Retail. Drive around collecting the rubbish left by customers and unload it into the dumpster. Faster work brings more money, which you can put into store improvements to raise the income.

pages.title: Rainbow Tsunami
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Lead an expanding group through an endless obstacle course in Rainbow Tsunami. Rescue more members, dodge vehicles and call on Rainbow Friends for help. Collect coins to buy upgrades, power-ups and clothes for future runs.

pages.title: Xmas Match 3 Dare
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Make rows or columns of three matching festive items in Xmas Match 3 Dare. Each completed challenge grants ten extra turns and another goal. Plan useful matches to keep extending the game instead of running out of moves.

pages.title: Tappy Driver
pages.creator: Viacheslav Boldt
pages.description: Steer a car with one-touch controls in Tappy Driver. Avoid obstacles as the speed rises, collect gold wheels and keep the tank supplied with fuel. Find keys to unlock more cars and pick up perks that help you finish.

pages.title: Design Master
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Carve objects from wood in Design Master. Use the tools to shape the piece to the requested design, then sell the finished work for gold. Take on more detailed patterns as you move through the levels.

pages.title: Guess the path
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fill every cell with a continuous number sequence in Guess the path. Each number must sit beside the next, so trace a route that connects one through the final value. Plan around the fixed clues as the grids grow larger.

pages.title: Crazy Car Stunt Car Games
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive police cars through ten stunt stages in Crazy Car Stunt Car Games. Obstacles slow the vehicle, but falling from the route is still a risk. Control your speed through narrow sections and reach the marked finish area.

pages.title: Arena: Noob vs Pro
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Enter team battles in Arena: Noob vs Pro. Work with other players, fight opponents around the arena and upgrade your character from a starting Noob. Use the changing situation to decide where your team needs another fighter.

pages.title: Cute Puppies Puzzle
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Assemble scenes of adventurous dogs in Cute Puppies Puzzle. Pick a picture and use the pieces' outlines and details to rebuild it. Explore images of puppies enjoying food, ice cream or imaginary trips into space.

pages.title: Stack Maze Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Slide through a maze and gather planks in Stack Maze Puzzle. Choose a route that collects enough boards to reach the end without getting stuck. Work through the different layouts as the paths become harder to plan.

pages.title: OCD Dreambot
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Close every door before the battery expires in OCD Dreambot. Guide the robot through ten platform puzzles and watch how much charge each action consumes. Use switches only when needed so there is enough power left to finish the route.

pages.title: Ultimate Car Arena
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Play football with sports cars in Ultimate Car Arena. Drive into the ball to send it toward goal and use your vehicle's speed to challenge for the next touch. Try jumps and flips while learning how each car handles.

pages.title: Dibbles 3. Desert Despair
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Lead the king through forty-four desert puzzles in Dibbles 3. Desert Despair. Assign tasks to the smaller Dibbles to create a safe route, using commands such as Melt and Clear. Plan around swamps, rocks and multiple starting or finishing points.

pages.title: Tap The Bubble
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Tap safe bubbles and collect their bonuses in Tap The Bubble. Watch for pieces that look dangerous before choosing the next target. Work through the colorful levels while keeping your hits away from harmful bubbles.

pages.title: Apples and Numbers
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: Practice counting and writing in Apples and Numbers. Drag digits into number sequences, identify quantities and trace numerals through the different activities. Use the apples and other pictures to connect each symbol with the amount it represents.

pages.title: Halloween Magic Connect
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Connect identical tiles in Halloween Magic Connect to clear the board. Choose pairs that leave routes through the remaining pieces and use hints when a match is hard to spot. Complete more levels to improve your position on the score table.

pages.title: Cookie Crush Christmas Edition
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Swap festive sweets into groups of three in Cookie Crush Christmas Edition. Use each cleared group to open space and bring new pieces into the board. Follow the level objectives through the Christmas-themed collection of puzzles.

pages.title: Battlefield Elite 3d
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Fight other players in pixel-style arenas in Battlefield Elite 3d. Move with WASD and aim with the mouse, upgrading equipment as you continue battling. Watch the nearby approaches to stay alive while trying to take out the opposition.

pages.title: Blend It Perfect
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Make fruit drinks in Blend It Perfect. Slide the ingredients into position for juicing and keep the character's fingers clear while the blender works. Complete the preparations to move through the different levels.

pages.title: Yummy Toast
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Prepare orders for customers in Yummy Toast. Tap the correct ingredients and kitchen items to make each serving, then hand it over once it is ready. Complete more cooking tasks to work toward the game's achievements.

pages.title: Tiny Archer
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Practice for a royal tournament in Tiny Archer. Shoot the round targets along the route and aim for the center to earn another arrow. Keep your aim accurate, since five missed bullseyes end the attempt.

pages.title: Dead Zed
pages.creator: 3KG
pages.description: Defend a safehouse from zombies in Dead Zed. Shoot incoming attackers, send search parties for survivors and weapons, and assign people to defense or repairs. Match each survivor's skills to the work your group needs done.

pages.title: Colors Monster
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Recognize colors with friendly creatures in Colors Monster. Look at the prompt and choose the monster whose shade matches the requested color. Work through the pictures to practice linking color names with what you see.

pages.title: Candy Jam
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swap adjacent candies into groups of at least three in Candy Jam. Check the current collection goal and direct your moves toward the pieces you need. Complete the objective to open the next board.

pages.title: Princess Outfitters
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Mia make her own party clothes in Princess Outfitters. Choose the design details and bring them together into a finished outfit. Try the available styling options to create something for her to wear that evening.

pages.title: Traffic Zone Car Racer
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Weave through endless traffic in Traffic Zone Car Racer. Use the arrow keys to find gaps between other vehicles and keep clear as the road gets crowded. Try to maintain a clean run while building speed and distance.

pages.title: Animal Rescue Robot Hero
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Rescue distressed wildlife in Animal Rescue Robot Hero. Use the flying ambulance robot and transport controls to reach animals that need help. Complete the emergency tasks and bring each animal out of danger as the missions progress.

pages.title: Singing Bird Escape
pages.creator: GAMES4KING
pages.description: Search a series of rooms for a way to free a captive bird in Singing Bird Escape. Inspect objects, collect useful items and work out the visual puzzles guarding the route. Follow the clues until you can open the bird's way out.

pages.title: Summer Beach Differences
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare two sunny scenes in Summer Beach Differences. Find five changed details in each pair by checking the same parts of both pictures. Select each difference to finish the current beach image and move on.

pages.title: Kids Little Broccoli
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Get a vegetable through a hazardous course in Kids Little Broccoli. Switch between the two sides of the platform to avoid obstacles blocking the way. Time each change so the broccoli can reach the end safely.

pages.title: Highway Robbers
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Race through traffic while avoiding police in Highway Robbers. Steer around cars and road obstacles, then collect coins to open more vehicles for the collection. Keep up a longer run to build a higher score.

pages.title: Mega Truck Race Monster Truck Racing Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Race big-wheeled vehicles through stunt routes in Mega Truck Race Monster Truck Racing Game. Control the steering across the rough sections and line up the truck for the next jump. Take on the competing vehicles while trying to finish the course.

pages.title: Chained Cars Impossible Tracks Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Drive two connected vehicles in Chained Cars Impossible Tracks Game. Match their movement and keep the speed under control so the chain stays intact. Guide the pair along the route without letting one car pull the other into trouble.

pages.title: Pimp My Car
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Clean vehicles for money in Pimp My Car. Cover the dirt with foam, rinse it away and work over any areas still needing attention. Use the earnings to buy more cars and keep developing the washing business.

pages.title: Ultimate Connect 4
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Drop colored pieces into a grid in Ultimate Connect 4. Make a line of four horizontally, vertically or diagonally while blocking the opponent's threats. Change the number of rows and columns to try a different-sized board.

pages.title: Cartoon Trucks Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six illustrated vehicle scenes in Cartoon Trucks Puzzle. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece layout and put the scattered sections in place. Use the trucks' shapes and colors to find the matching edges.

pages.title: Stop The Bus
pages.creator: Feig Ltd.
pages.description: Build a high-value hand against three computer players in Stop The Bus. Try to approach thirty-one using one suit, then stop the bus when you want to end the exchange. The lowest hand loses a fare ticket after the final turn.

pages.title: Stickman Crash
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Choose a pose and movement for a ragdoll in Stickman Crash. Test the combination against the action required by the level, then adjust it when the result falls short. Explore more setups as you unlock additional features.

pages.title: Kawasaki Ninja 650 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles into place to reconstruct motorcycle pictures in Kawasaki Ninja 650 Slide. Select one of three images and try the different puzzle modes. Follow the bike's outlines and background details to work out the correct arrangement.

pages.title: Speed Racer
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Steer through traffic and build speed in Speed Racer. Keep an eye on the vehicles ahead and use the keyboard or touch buttons to avoid them. Stay in the run long enough to improve your high score.

pages.title: Butterflies Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild six pictures of an anime girl and butterflies in Butterflies Puzzle. Choose among four piece counts and sort the image by colors, shapes and background. Fit the pieces together to reveal the full illustration.

pages.title: Best Combat Arena 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight through block-style arenas in Best Combat Arena 2020. Try modes with soldiers or zombies and use the weapons available to survive the encounter. Move between cover as you take on computer enemies or other players.

pages.title: Foot Care
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Run a simulated treatment clinic in Foot Care. Inspect each patient's feet and follow the prompts to use the appropriate on-screen tools. Complete the care tasks for injuries and other problems before the next patient arrives.

pages.title: Trendy School Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help students update their looks in Trendy School Fashion. Choose makeup and put together outfits from uniform pieces or dressier options. Coordinate the final details to give each girl a look for the school day.

pages.title: Big City Limo Car Driving Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Carry passengers around a city in Big City Limo Car Driving Game. Guide the long car through streets and parking areas, leaving enough turning room for its rear. Bring each passenger to the requested destination.

pages.title: Magic Fairy Tale Princess Game
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Dress Flora in Magic Fairy Tale Princess Game. Try her gowns, hairstyles and accessories to build a coordinated royal look. Use the choices in her enchanted wardrobe to give the fairy-tale princess her own style.

pages.title: Crush to Party: Christmas Edition
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Match or change festive faces in Crush to Party: Christmas Edition. React to the Santa and Mrs. Christmas pictures to complete each round. Between puzzles, switch to decorating and build a room for your own holiday celebration.

pages.title: Drift Car Stunt Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive over raised stunt routes in Drift Car Stunt Simulator. Control the car through narrow stretches, then carry speed where the track gives you room to drift. Keep the wheels on the route as you work toward the finish.

pages.title: Christmas Eve Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Park a car in a winter setting in Christmas Eve Parking. Use the arrow keys to line up the vehicle and steer around the space available. Approach carefully enough to finish inside the marked spot.

pages.title: Hyper Merry Christmas Party
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Turn over holiday cards in Hyper Merry Christmas Party. Reveal one picture, then select another card you think hides the same design. Use the information from mismatches to clear every pair from the table.

pages.title: Rise Egg Up
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Move a shield above a rising egg in Rise Egg Up. Push hazards away before they enter its path and keep checking the space overhead. Use the shield's position to clear a safe channel for the egg.

pages.title: Zombie Road
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Drive through a post-apocalyptic landscape in Zombie Road. Steer around road hazards and smash through the undead where you have a clear path. Keep control of the car as the route fills with more threats.

pages.title: Bottle Shooting
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Aim at glass targets in Bottle Shooting. Use the mouse to line up the shot and fire when the bottle is in sight. Try three weapon models as you work through the shooting levels.

pages.title: ToysRace
pages.creator: sienar games
pages.description: Race small vehicles in ToysRace. Build speed along the course, line up for ramps and make the jump without losing your route. Use WASD or the arrow keys to keep the toy car moving toward the finish.

pages.title: Lollipop True Color
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Identify the color of the candy shown in Lollipop True Color. Choose answers quickly as the pictures change and try to fit more correct guesses into the round. You have one minute to build your score.

pages.title: Move Block
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Slide pieces to open a route in Move Block. Inspect the arrangement and shift the blocking shapes into spare space. Keep working until the target block has a clear path out of the puzzle.

pages.title: Carl Transforms Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reassemble five pictures of a changing vehicle in Carl Transforms Truck. Select an image and choose the number of pieces before beginning. Match the truck's details and place every piece where it belongs to complete the board.

pages.title: Princess Birthday Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Emma celebrate in Princess Birthday Party. Pick a party outfit, then decorate the hall that Mia has prepared for the guests. Finish the setting with a birthday cake before the friends arrive.

pages.title: Amazing Bubble Breaker
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Clear groups of colored bubbles in Amazing Bubble Breaker. Try easy, medium or hard mode and look for removals that leave another useful group. Change the visual theme and work toward a better result on the online rankings.

pages.title: English Tracing Book
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Practice letters and words in English Tracing Book. Follow the guides to draw the shapes on screen and connect the written symbols with their examples. Work through one activity at a time to build familiarity with English characters.

pages.title: Annie Halloween Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Annie ready for a costume celebration in Annie Halloween Party. Choose from the clothing options and add a Halloween-themed makeup design. Bring the outfit and face paint together before she heads to the party.

pages.title: Mewtrix
pages.creator: Flying Sheep Studios
pages.description: Rotate and place falling kittens in Mewtrix. Make touching groups of at least three cats of the same color to clear them, and arrange longer chains for more points. Keep finding room as the pieces begin falling faster.

pages.title: Invasion2018
pages.creator: Gringo
pages.description: Fight aliens across Planet X in Invasion2018. Choose the control scheme that suits you at the start, then move through the levels clearing enemies. Watch the route ahead as you work toward the next area.

pages.title: TapTap Shots
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Tap to send a basketball toward the hoop in TapTap Shots. Make each basket before the timer expires and be ready to adjust to the next setup. Keep scoring to extend the run and improve your total.

pages.title: City Theft
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Make a rooftop getaway with a grappling hook in City Theft. Jump obstacles, hold to swing on the rope and release when the momentum can carry you to the next building. Keep the thief above the streets without missing a landing.

pages.title: Math Drops
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Drop numbered pieces into alignment in Math Drops. Aim horizontally, vertically or diagonally at the value you want to remove. Look at how each placement changes the board before choosing the next drop.

pages.title: My Nail Art Salon
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Serve customers at My Nail Art Salon by creating the nail designs they want. Apply the colors and details quickly enough to keep the business moving. Earn money from completed manicures as you work through more appointments.

pages.title: Caterpillar Crossing
pages.creator: pongoeater
pages.description: Help a small creature reach the ladder in Caterpillar Crossing. Eat leaves to grow longer, then use that length to span gaps in the route. Plan where to move as you work through forty increasingly difficult puzzles.

pages.title: Pipe Beer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Build a beer pipeline before the liquid starts flowing in Pipe Beer. Rotate the available sections into a connected route and make sure it reaches the required minimum length. Use the countdown to prepare as much of the line as possible.

pages.title: Rachel Summer Fashion Trend!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare Rachel for a beach weekend in Rachel Summer Fashion Trend! Start with makeup, then choose a swimsuit and a surfboard to match. Try the different options before finishing her look for the water.

pages.title: Solitaire 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sort cards into suit piles from ace to king in Solitaire 1. Look for plays on the table that uncover more cards and create another available move. Continue until every foundation is complete and the deal is cleared.

pages.title: Couple Spring Trends
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress Anna and Jack for a park outing in Couple Spring Trends. Choose Anna's look first, then move to Jack's clothes and coordinate the pair. Finish their outfits for a warm spring walk.

pages.title: Eliza Winter Adventure
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get a princess ready for the slopes in Eliza Winter Adventure. Browse ski outfits and choose whether she will go skiing or snowboarding. Coordinate the clothes and equipment before her day on the mountain.
